subject: How to produce multiple qplots using plyr?

messages.author: 8078800b7ede70d2
messages.subject: How to produce multiple qplots using plyr?
parts:
How to produce multiple qplots using plyr:

#data
dl <- replicate(5, rnorm(100), simplify=F)
names(dl) <- paste("data", 1:5)

#from list
l_ply(dl, qplot)

#From data.frame
df <- ldply(dl, transform, names(dl))
d_ply(df, ".id", qplot)

These doesn't seem tor produce anything?

-jrara

messages.author: 936ef8c6d12fc338
messages.subject: RE: How to produce multiple qplots using plyr?
parts:
I must correct myself. It seems like qplot does have a default plot when only data are supplied.

The plots are not shown due to FAQ 7.22 (http://cran.r-project.org/doc/FAQ/R-FAQ.html#Why-do-lattice_002ftrellis-graphics-not-work_003f). You need a print statement for plotting inside a function.

library('ggplot2')

dl <- replicate(5, rnorm(100), simplify=F)
names(dl) <- paste("data", 1:5)
